items.title_cn: 基于术前CT的影像组学列线图预测胰十二指肠切除术后急性胰腺炎的开发与验证
items.title_en: Development and validation of a preoperative CT-based radiomics nomogram for predicting postpancreatectomy acute pancreatitis after pancreatoduodenectomy
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题表明其开发并验证了一种基于术前CT的影像组学列线图，用于预测胰十二指肠切除术后胰腺切除术后急性胰腺炎。由于摘要未提供，无法总结具体发现。

items.title_cn: 妊娠期双相性高甘油三酯血症伴载脂蛋白C-II缺乏
items.title_en: Biphasic hypertriglyceridemia in pregnancy with apolipoprotein C-II deficiency
items.abstract_cn: 载脂蛋白C-II（ApoC-II）缺乏症是家族性乳糜微粒血症综合征（FCS）的一种罕见遗传病因，患者易发生严重高甘油三酯血症和急性胰腺炎。指导妊娠期管理的证据有限。我们报告一例ApoC-II缺乏症（ApoC-II Wakayama突变）女性患者，其甘油三酯（TG）呈双相升高。TG在妊娠中期显著升高，经强化饮食限制后改善，妊娠晚期再次升至1400 mg/dL（15.8 mmol/L）。由于患者始终无症状且TG对饮食治疗有反应，未启动药物治疗和血浆置换。于36周引产，经阴道分娩顺利，产后TG迅速下降。本病例强调了FCS中按妊娠分期进行监测以及个体化重新评估饮食、药物、血浆置换和分娩策略的重要性。
items.abstract_en: Apolipoprotein C-II (ApoC-II) deficiency is a rare genetic cause of familial chylomicronemia syndrome (FCS) that predisposes affected individuals to severe hypertriglyceridemia and acute pancreatitis. Evidence guiding management during pregnancy is limited. We report a woman with ApoC-II deficiency (ApoC-II Wakayama mutation) who showed a biphasic triglyceride (TG) elevation. TG increased markedly in the second trimester, improved with intensified dietary restriction, and rose again to 1400 mg/dL (15.8 mmol/L) in the third trimester. Because she remained asymptomatic and TG had responded to dietary therapy, medical therapy and plasma exchange were not initiated. Labour was induced at 36 weeks, resulting in uncomplicated vaginal delivery and rapid postpartum TG reduction. This case highlights trimester-specific monitoring and individualized reassessment of dietary, medical, plasma exchange, and delivery strategies in FCS.
items.summary_cn: 该病例报告描述了一名ApoC-II缺乏（Wakayama突变）孕妇出现双相性甘油三酯升高，孕中期显著升高后经强化饮食限制改善，孕晚期再次升至1400 mg/dL，因无症状且对饮食治疗有反应而未启动药物或血浆置换，36周引产后顺利阴道分娩且产后TG迅速下降。研究强调FCS妊娠期需按孕期分段监测并个体化评估饮食、药物、血浆置换及分娩策略。

items.title_cn: 术后血清钙与胰十二指肠切除术后并发症相关性的回顾性多中心研究
items.title_en: Association between postoperative serum calcium and complications after pancreaticoduodenectomy in a retrospective multicenter study
items.abstract_cn: 血清钙是评估急性胰腺炎严重程度的重要指标。胰腺炎和胰十二指肠切除术（PD）后的生理过程相似；然而，血清钙是否与PD术后结局相关尚不清楚。本研究分析了术后第3、6、9和12天的血清钙。采用Logistic回归识别血清钙、临床术后胰瘘（POPF）及其他并发症之间的相关性。采用广义相加模型（GAM）确定血清钙阈值。采用限制性立方样条（RCS）可视化血清钙与结局之间的线性或非线性关系。采用潜在类别分析（LCA）根据各时间点的血清钙水平识别潜在类别。结合广义相加混合效应模型（GAMM）分析四个时间点血清钙与结局之间的关系。本研究分析了447例PD患者。四个时间点的血清钙水平与临床POPF呈负相关，使用GAM计算得出的阈值分别为1.96和1.98。采用RCS以可能的L型可视化血清钙与结局之间的关系。我们通过LCA识别出四个潜在类别，进一步的Logistic回归表明，持续较低的血清钙水平与临床POPF风险增加相关。GAMM暴露的术后血清钙与临床POPF呈负相关。在这个回顾性队列中，较低的术后血清钙水平与临床POPF及其他术后并发症的较高发生几率相关。这些发现具有探索性，在血清钙可用于临床风险评估之前，需要前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_en: Serum calcium is an important indicator for assessing the severity of acute pancreatitis. The physiological processes following pancreatitis and pancreaticoduodenectomy (PD) are similar; however, it is unknown whether serum calcium is associated with outcomes after PD. The present study analyzed serum calcium on postoperative days 3, 6, 9, and 12. Logistic regression was used to identify correlations between serum calcium, clinical postoperative pancreatic fistula (POPF), and other complications. Generalized additive models (GAM) were used to determine serum calcium thresholds. Restricted cubic spline (RCS) was used to visualize linear or non-linear relationships between serum calcium and outcomes. Latent class analysis (LCA) was used to identify potential categories based on serum calcium levels at various time points. Generalized additive mixed-effects models (GAMM) were combined to analyze the relationship between serum calcium and outcomes at four-time points. The study analyzed 447 PD patients. Serum calcium levels at four-time points were negatively associated with clinical POPF, with thresholds of 1.96 and 1.98 calculated using GAM. RCS was used to visualize the relationship between serum calcium and outcomes in a possible L-type. We identified four potential classes through LCA, and further logistic regression demonstrated that persistently lower serum calcium levels were associated with an increased risk of clinical POPF. GAMM-exposed postoperative serum calcium was negatively associated with clinical POPF. In this retrospective cohort, lower postoperative serum calcium levels were associated with higher odds of clinical POPF and other postoperative complications. These findings are exploratory and require prospective validation before serum calcium can be considered for clinical risk assessment.
items.summary_cn: 该回顾性多中心研究发现，胰十二指肠切除术后第3、6、9、12天的血清钙水平与临床术后胰瘘（POPF）及其他并发症呈负相关，持续较低的术后血清钙水平与临床POPF风险增加相关。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
